subject: Re: Coordinating ZenithOps + AWS joint marketplace demo and recording
messages:
From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@zenithops.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@aws-partners.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + joint marketplace demo — proposed dates

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. ZenithOps is targeting a short co-sell demo to show our connector + listing flow for the AWS Marketplace catalog and we'd love Redwood to join as the inference partner. High-level ask: 30–40 minute live demo (10 min intros, 20 min demo, 10 min Q&A) and a brief run-through of the marketplace listing flow + procurement notes.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tues Jun 27, 09:00–09:45
- Thurs Jun 29, 11:00–11:45
- Mon Jul 3, 08:30–09:15

Please let us know which works best for Redwood and whether we should include an AWS rep for the procurement/marketplace section (cc'd Maria). We can share an agenda and runbook once date/time is locked.

Attachments: sample slide deck referenced (we'll send a formal agenda if we lock a slot).

Thanks,
Carlos Mendes
BizDev Lead, ZenithOps
zenithops-demo@zenithops.com

To: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@zenithops.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@aws-partners.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + joint marketplace demo — proposed dates

Carlos —

Appreciate the invite. We can definitely join. My availability this week aligns best with Tue Jun 27. Kimberly (cc) will drive the technical demo flow and Vanessa (cc) will handle partner ops. Maria — glad you're on the thread; if you can join the procurement/marketplace segment that would be ideal.

Proposed confirmed slot (tentative):
- Tue Jun 27, 09:00–09:45 PT — Redwood co-hosts (Jordan intro + Kimberly demo)

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can ZenithOps share a 1‑page agenda and one-runbook doc by Friday (Jun 16) so we can sync slides and who speaks when?
2) We usually record these for internal follow-ups — ok to record? We'll also want to capture the Marketplace listing URL ahead of time.

If 09:00 doesn't work for AWS, we can shift to 09:30. Otherwise, lock us in for Jun 27 and we'll prep.

Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Thanks — looping in a tentative run-of-show so we can land on speakers and timing. Carlos, I'll drop the agenda and a short runbook — attaching skeletons here so everyone can comment.

Run-of-show (30–40m):
- 0:00–02:00: Quick intros (Jordan, Carlos, Maria)
- 02:00–12:00: ZenithOps: marketplace listing + procurement notes (Carlos)
- 12:00–28:00: Redwood: demo of inference + integration with ZenithOps connector (Kimberly)
- 28:00–40:00: Q&A and next steps (all)

Ops notes:
- Recording: yes, will use Zoom cloud recording. Please advise any NDAs or concerns.
- Shared assets: please add final slide deck and any sensitive artifacts to the Drive folder linked below (request access if needed).
- Runbook: see attached runbook spreadsheet for host cues + fallbacks.

Attachments: ZenithOps_Demo_Agenda.pdf, ZenithOps_Runbook.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cZenithOps-Demo-Assets

Thanks all — happy to join. Quick update from the marketplace side: 09:30 PT on Tue Jun 27 is better for our team due to another customer sync. If that works for Redwood and ZenithOps, let's lock 09:30–10:15 PT (we can keep the demo to 40m and 15m for AWS procurement discussion).

Checklist before we lock:
- Share final slide deck and runbook by EOD Fri Jun 23.
- Provide the marketplace listing preview link so we can reference it in the demo: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prod-ABCDE12345
- Confirm recording and who owns the recording (Redwood will host; ZenithOps OK with cloud recording?).
- Provide any compliance/SCIM notes if procurement will request them.

If everyone agrees, I'll send a calendar invite for Tue Jun 27, 09:30–10:15 PT and include a short agenda and the marketplace link.

—Maria Gonzalez
Partner Solutions Manager, AWS Marketplace
maria.gonzalez@aws-partners.com
